fieldValues.title: One writer at a time per repository, inside the server
fieldValues.move: A per-repository write lock in the registry server around every write service call. Readers never wait. srs-rust#813 gives the batch seam when a multi-write service needs atomicity.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Concurrent editing by several people of one record; that is git branches and pull requests, or later a CRDT.
fieldValues.falsifier: Write latency under the lock becomes visible to an interactive editor.
fieldValues.return_when: Two people edit one repository live.
